## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Maccupāsamuttipañha* ("The Snare of Death") is a discourse in the *Milindapañha* belonging to the Late Sutta collection. Set as a dialogue between King Milinda and the arahant elder Nāgasena in the royal city of Sāgala, the section is drawn upon in secondary discussions concerning the doctrinal function and efficacy of *paritta* (protective verses) [Si Ti La 2014].
